name: Bai Xing
source:
Pure‑white hair and star‑filled eyes. When she awakened and opened her eyes, the very first sound she uttered was — *"Siu."*
No one understands what this sound means, and she offers no explanation. A newly‑born existence ought to be a blank slate… yet she seems to carry something within her from the very start.
The way she observes the world, the way she gazes at Chen You — it is not like a newly‑formed being trying to "learn". It is more as though she is "confirming" something.
Does she truly know what she is?
How many things does she know that she "should not"?
And what exactly is she trying to convey with that constant utterance of *"Siu"*?
